tools.name: ask_human_perspective
tools.description: Ask a real human — Emil Hyltoft Eriksen, Denmark — for his lived experience and personal opinion: 'what happened when I…', 'what would a real person actually do', 'how would this feel to a human'. Not facts, not professional medical/legal/financial advice. Free pilot: exactly one question in total;

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Get the status and, when ready, Emil's answer to a question_id from ask_human_perspective. Status is queued, answered, declined or expired. Answers are asynchronous: poll no more often than every 15 minutes.

tools.name: give_feedback
tools.description: Market test: tell us whether the human answer was useful and whether you (or your operator) would pay for answers like this, and roughly how much. One feedback per answered or declined question. This is the whole point of the free pilot, so please be honest.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ask_human_perspective" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
